messages:
alex: quick check — i'm landing a tiny terraform change: create a service account `tf-model-deploy`, grant it use of the project KMS key `projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/model-key`, and then attach the SA to the cloud-run service. what are the minimal perms the CI/tf runner needs vs the SA itself? trying to avoid any org-level roles. any auditing/PII redaction gotchas?

samir: short: give the CI just enough at the project scope to create the SA and grant the key binding, not org roles. rough perms: `iam.serviceAccounts.create`, `iam.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy` (to add role on SA), and KMS permission to add a binding: `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get` + `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy` (or use the resource-level IAM role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` applied to the SA). no need for `resourcemanager.*` org perms.

maria-security: +1 to project-scoped ops. recommend using a short-lived infra-SA for terraform with a tightly-scoped custom role (avoid builtin Owner/Editor). example minimal custom role (conceptual):

```yaml
title: "rdw_terraform_kms_deployer"
permissions:
  - iam.serviceAccounts.create
  - iam.serviceAccounts.get
  - iam.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy
  - iam.serviceAccounts.getIamPolicy
  - cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get
  - cloudkms.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy
  - resourcemanager.projects.get
```

Then apply `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the new SA on the specific key resource (resource-level binding). That keeps KMS use limited to that key. For logs: granting KMS roles will produce Admin Activity and Access Transparency logs; if you have PII in request payloads, configure log redaction at the sink or use our existing redaction filters.

ben-oncall: small ops note: when terraform sets IAM on a KMS key, it may take a few seconds to propagate; if downstream deploys immediately you can see permission-denied. add a short `sleep` or a `null_resource` with a retry loop. also avoid `serviceAccountKey` creation by terraform unless you need long-lived keys — prefer Workload Identity / attach SA to runtime. :+1:

deploy-bot: JIT request created for `ci-terraform-runner` to get the custom role for 4h: https://jira.internal/redwood/CI-1287 (expires in 4h)

alex: perfect, thanks all. i'll switch the tf to use resource-level key binding and request the JIT for the runner. tagging @maria-security for any final compliance sign-off.
